description: Purchase of 600 buses for the Intercity/Long-Distance Services of the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Budgetary provisions of Rs.14,400 million have been allocated for the Project of Purchasing 600 new 49-54 - Seater Standard buses in the year 2026 under the Public Investment Programme. After the allocation of such provisions, the Road Safety Plan - 2025-2026 has been introduced. Under the said plan, buses used for passenger transport have been identified as safe vehicles. Accordingly, the categories of buses suitable for intercity and long-distance services and the minimum specifications applicable thereto have been prepared. According to those specifications, Deluxe model (air-conditioned) buses should be used in intercity and long-distance services. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to take further steps to purchase more comfortable Deluxe (Air-conditioned) buses instead of the 600 new Standard buses for which provisions have already been allocated, was approved by the Cabinet.
